justification: Assessment returned INVALID at step 0024 and identified exactly the ground-truth defect: the unjustified implicit lemma that 3-colourability of the interior arrangement graph G-bar plus 3-colourability of the boundary part dG implies chi(G)<=3. It supplies the same K4 witness family used by the ground truth (K4 as the union of a triangle and star edges / of parts each 3-colourable, with chi(K4)=4), and correctly notes the colourings need not be compatible on the joining edges. It adds the further valid observation that dG is an even 2n-cycle, so the stated sufficient condition is vacuous. Same defect, valid witness.
